items.summary: To whosoever is behind the design of all the pictures that CKCAPITAL uses, be it in announcements, giveaways, promotions and so, your creativity is top notch and you are absolutely doing a great job. Kudos and keep it up.

Thanks to the support and staff team to organize these games continuously. It really helpful for a lot of traders who have skills but are not financially capable of buying account and show casing the skills. CK Capital is really a gem in the prop firm space.
@Tanvir | Mod CK Capital He Is the most mind-blowing support member i have ever seen. Because he solved my query and gave me an Exceptional Support for my question. He is just Awesome.
My macbook is at 3% rn but thanks Adarsh, very quick to respond and helping me. Love you gang. Gonna go pass phase 1 now.

My experience with CK Capital was outstanding! The team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine commitment to helping me achieve my financial goals. Their clear communication and personalized approach made all the difference. I highly recommend CK Capital for anyone seeking reliable and effective financial services. Great job!

Just wanted to say thank you for the support and prompt feedback. You guys are really killing it, ive never been more comfortable trading a prop account. Keep up the great work, God has many plans in store for you guys. Once again thanks a million, first class service.

I used to share chart in chart room just for fun and sharing thoughts and ideas. I never thought I would get 2nd place there and win 25k account. Even if I had not got anything it wouldn't matter to me. But still Thank you CK Capital and @Kd for rewarding my hobby.

I recently had an issue with my account that was mistakenly flagged for a breach. I reached out to support, and @TMT was incredibly kind and helpful throughout the process. He resolved the issue very quickly, and the entire experience was smooth and efficient. Really appreciate the excellent support!

I had an issue where I was unable to do my KYC. I was able to create a support ticket on a Friday night and got a response immediately from @Tai Lung. On Monday 8am sharp I was able to submit my KYC verification which was fast and easy. I received my contract within 24hrs of submitting KYC. Overall I was happy for the speedy response and resolution of my issue from the support team.

I recently got my first ever payout and it just happened to be with CK capital. Didn't have much money to start trading with, but their banger discounts hooked me up with a 10k account. Discipline, trust in the process and trust in God made it happen in year and a half. The best part is I already have another payout in process awaiting approval with more than double my first payout. Thank you CK capital looking forward to more payouts with you guys.
My first payout and inshallah many more to come. Thanks to CK capital and the team.

Big day for me. My first ever prop firm i've ever passed my phase1 and 2 and actually been paid from. Taken shortcuts in the past and used bots but still never got paid but this time, it was an achievement without cutting corners.
Thanks CK that I got my payout yesterday, tho it took a bit longer than expected, I hope and believe that CK is improving and will be doing better in future! Have faith

2026 is definitely going to be a great year!! First payout after a lot of hard work and tough lessons but the journey has only made me stronger!! Thanks CK Capital for giving me the opportunity to prove myself!!

Hello everyone, that was tough night haha, i could n believe about that payout is so unreal but same as our dream, so work hard and make them come true. I so thankfully @Kar | COO CK Capital as he assist to me in few last days, also whole CK community on discord as they support me in that journey.

I got my first payout from CK Capital! Lots of hard work went into getting this and I'm really proud of myself. The support team was great with their fast responses to my questions. Looking forward to continuing this trading journey with CK!
Thanks to everyone at CK for my first payout with you. Once approved it came through to rise within a few minutes. Patience paid!

Received my full payouts today, I would like to thank Momin | Staff CK Capital & Tanvir | Mod CK Capital for assisting me in my support ticket despite having tech issue for my payout withdrawal. They have been very patient to assure me the tech issue would be fixed by the team and the payout speaks for itself. Great to have both of you in CK capital assisting the traders like us. Shoutout to Dan, since joining WchampFX it has been eye-opening. Lastly, I truly believe CK capital keep their promises and deliver the payouts.

Just received my 1st CK payout. It took quiet a while (almost 1 month) and I was already afraid based on some negative experience. But finally I got it and the support during the waiting time was always great. I hope this is the starting point of a success story.
First payout with CK Capital. Hopefully the first of many to come.
First ever payout. Honestly, an awesome feeling, can't wait for the opportunity for the next one!

I want to express my gratitude to CK Capital Prop Firm and its CEO, Dan Cheung, for the prompt payout of my funded account. Despite the significant amount and their status as a new firm, they delivered the payout on time with only a slight delay, which I have no issue with. I also appreciate the support staff at CK Capital for their assistance in keeping me calm and composed during the waiting period.
2nd payout from CK, real proof they do pay with no fuss. I'm a funded trader with them and will continue to support them and look forward to seeing them grow and be one of the best. Thanks Team CK.

First Time with CK Capital! Finally Delivered. Small Amount but it's just the beginning. Took 10 business days arrived faster than I expected. Would Love to see the upcoming updates on Payout time. CK to the Moon!

I just received my second payout from CK Capital - and I can't even put into words how happy and proud I am to be part of this company! From the very beginning, I had trust and I invested in CK Capital - and let me tell you: it was so worth it. Everything runs smoothly, transparently, and without any issues. Here, you get the freedom to trade the way you want. No unnecessary restrictions, no pressure - finally, a platform that puts traders first and truly allows you to work and grow. I will strongly recommend CK Capital to everyone I know in the trading space.

Elhamdulillah just received my first payout with CK Capital - truly grateful! The support team is top-notch, always responsive and helpful. Proud to be a funded trader here and excited for the journey ahead - CK Capital forever.
THANK YOU so much CK Capital! Means the world! Thanks for all the support throughout from start to finish! Looking forward to continuing my journey with the CK Fam!
Very first payout with CK Capital. Still need to pinch myself that this is actually real. Thank you so so much to my CK family. Appreciate all of you so so much. US vs US!!! Let's go!
